description_en: Changes the billing method for a Tair instance between subscription and pay-as-you-go
description_zh: 转换云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的付费类型，支持按量付费和包年包月付费类型之间的相互转换
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore transform-instance-charge-type --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --charge-type PrePaid --region cn-hangzhou
name: TransformInstanceChargeType

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query instance IDs
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration, in months. Valid values: 1 to 9, 12, 24, and 36.

This parameter is available and required only when the ChargeType parameter is set to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
包年包月的付费时长，单位为月，取值：1~9、12、24、36。
当ChargeType参数取值为PrePaid时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

true: Automatic payment. This is the default value.

false: Manual payment. In the console, choose Billing Management > Renewal Management in the top navigation bar. In the navigation pane on the left, click Or\rs > My Or\rs to find and pay for the or*er
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费，取值：

true：自动付费，默认值。
false：手动付费。您需要在控制台的顶部菜单栏，单击费用 > 续费管理，然后单击左侧导航栏的订单管理 > 我的订单，找到目标订单进行支付
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The target billing method. Valid values:

PrePaid: subscription. If you set this parameter to this value, you must also specify the Period parameter.

PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
要转换到的付费类型，取值：
PrePaid：包年包月，传入本值时，您还需要传入Period参数。
PostPaid：按量付费
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the instance. Valid values:

true: Auto-renewal is enabled.

false (default): Auto-renewal is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费，取值：
true：开启。
false（默认）：不开启
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal period, in months. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 6, and 12.

This parameter is required when the AutoRenew parameter is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期，单位为月，取值：1、2、3、6、12。

当AutoRenew取值为true时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

EndTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the instance.

This parameter is returned only when you change the billing method of an instance from pay-as-you-go to subscription
EndTime.description_zh:
实例的到期时间。
当实例的付费类型从按量付费转换为包年包月时，本参数才会返回具体的值
